login_prompt.title: Log in for the full experience
login_prompt.description: The button below will open the Nexus Mods website, please click “authorise” or log in / register if required.

progress.title: Log in or register on the Nexus Mods website

token.invalid: Your token wasn’t recognised. Copy it again using the button on the website.
token.failed: Logging in with this token didn’t work: {{error}}
